title: Panda's Subordinates
paragraphs: “There, there, babies sure are cute, aren’t they, Naofumi.”
“Yeah. So I’m a father now, huh… It’s a strange feeling.”
“That’s right, Naofumi-chan.”
“You too, Lars-chan.”

Panda was lying on the bed, dozing off, I say. Incidentally, it had already been several days since the birth. If these were human babies, they’d still be considered newborns, but Older Sister’s children were showing the kind of vigor you’d expect from infants half a year old already. This is a place where thinking in Japanese terms would lead you sorely astray, indeed. Older Sister’s kind are those capable of transforming into beast form, a race of this other world.
“Ren, Itsuki, and everyone else came to see the newborn baby.”
“Ah, is that so. How’s it look? Honestly, it’s so full of energy it’s giving me trouble. How much can one baby possibly suck down… By the way, isn’t it time for food yet?”
“Larsa… you sure eat a lot.”
“I get hungry, don’t I? What’s wrong with that?”

Elephant scolded Panda, but Panda just brazened it out in response. Father’s cooking is truly delicious, and it gives you energy, indeed. Incidentally, Elephant had apparently gone with Father and the others to Panda’s village around the time we were having our cooking contests in Zeltoble, and in the flow of things Father had done some diplomatic work in the Siltvelt region, resolving some issues back at Panda’s home village. According to Father, the whole thing played out almost exactly the same way as when he’d gone to Siltvelt before. Well done, I say! It irks me that Rival was there too, but I wanted to go along as well, indeed. Incidentally, apparently Kou had gone out together with Elephant too.
“I’ll make more.”

Panda seemed to be pestering Father for more food, I say. But there were already plates of finished food lined up next to Panda. Truly, quite the eater, that Panda. Seems like it was being thoroughly pampered, indeed.
“Even if it’s not Naofumi saying it, babies really are cute, Larsazusa.”
“Yes, such a lively baby.”
“Right? Since we’re here, mind entertaining it for a bit? That guy and my parents and grandfather went and prepared all sorts of toys for it.”
Panda pointed at the toy box in the room, apparently having prepared toys to keep Ren and Itsuki entertaining the baby with.
“Itsuki-kun! Leave it to us! Time for Caretaker Golem to show its true power!”
“That’s right, kyu!”
Rafuemon and Filoko-chan both stepped up together to volunteer, indeed. That sort of thing is right up their alley. Meanwhile Rafumi seemed to be in support mode for Ren, preparing supplies instead.
“Raph~”
Raph-chan, apparently taking swift command of the situation, perched atop Big Sister’s head and waved a toy drum in front of the baby that Itsuki and Ren were holding, I say.
“Ah, thank you all so much. If everyone crowds in too close we won’t be able to move, so let’s keep some distance and take turns caring for them.”
“R-right. How do you even change a diaper?”
“You do it like this. Though— looks like it’s not bathroom time yet.”
“Oh, they cry in a way you can tell when it’s bathroom time, so you take them to the privy then. These kids are surprisingly low-maintenance, so don’t worry.”
“I-Is that so. That’s… reassuring, I suppose?”
What outrageous learning abilities these babies possessed, indeed. According to Father, Older Sister, and Panda, they might have picked it up by listening while still in the womb.
“Father! Let me help too, I say!”
“Thanks, Motoyasu-kun.”
I looked at Rival, indeed.
“Rival! You haven’t laid a hand on Father while I wasn’t looking, have you, I say?!”
“Didn’t do anything, nano.”
“Motoyasu-kun, I already have Sadeena-san and the others who were expecting, you know? Do I really seem that shameless to you?”

Ugh… Father was smiling while radiating pure pressure. Indeed, kind Father truly is the devoted type. Even setting that aside, he’s not the sort of man who would do something so lacking in sincerity. Rival also waved a hand as if to say she had no intention of forcing herself on anyone. Curses! I say!
“I’ve been able to confirm a lot from old texts and Faubrey records regarding heroes’ children, but this is amazing, isn’t it.”
“Some wild monsters can live on their own right after birth.”
Doctor and Assistant, dispatched as researchers from Faubrey, were observing the babies’ condition, indeed. Rival perched on Assistant’s shoulder.
“So lively, nano, it’s nice. Big Sister.”
“It really is… They look happy.”
“Nano~”
Here I ought to be talking with Father while keeping wary of Rival, indeed.
“I made sure to properly prepare baby outfits, I say!”
“Thanks, Motoyasu-kun. I’ll put them to good use.”

I had prepared baby clothes designed to match each child—orca designs and panda designs, I say. Panda’s child got an orca costume, and Older Sister’s child got a panda costume, indeed. On top of that, I’d covered every design imaginable. Truly, a veritable mountain of them! For this is my heartfelt devotion, indeed!

“Imiya-chan’s also making clothes, so with you and the others handling the clothing side, Motoyasu-kun, we’re never short. Come to think of it, with the cooking competition the other day too, maybe you should look into entering some fashion competitions, Motoyasu-kun.”
“If Father says so, then I shall become this world’s top fashion designer, I say! Let’s go, Mole!”
“Eh? Ah, yes.”

When I tossed the topic her way, Mole properly responded. And so, amid this lively atmosphere, the birth celebration for Older Sister and Panda proceeded. The children left in Ren and Itsuki’s care were raising happy, playful voices together, though the surrounding adults seemed to be growing a bit worn out, indeed. Father watched over that scene alongside Panda and Older Sister.
“It’d be nice if the kids get along and play together.”
“Ah— yeah, that’d be nice. Growing faster than I expected, which is a relief. Geez, when it was in my belly it was so full of energy it was almost scary, but it came out surprisingly easily.”
“That’s good.”
“And well… when I was a kid myself, I used to feel a little envious of having siblings.”
“I grew up in a peaceful world, so— I’ve got a younger brother. We got compared to each other a lot growing up, but I’d say we got along pretty well as brothers.”
Father spoke to Panda while lost in memory. Panda, stroking its belly, reached out and grabbed Father’s hand for some reason.
“What’s wrong, Lars-san?”
“Just hoping my kid doesn’t feel that kind of loneliness.”
“You’ve also got the one with Sadeena-san, so it’ll be fine. Both of them are healthy and lively.”
Panda was fidgeting about for some reason. What on earth was going on, I wonder?
“……It kicked up such a storm before it was born, and now that it’s gone I can’t settle down somehow.”

The conversation seemed to circle back a bit, didn’t it? Panda, what exactly are you trying to say, I wonder? I felt some vague sense of unease, but Father just had a gentle expression on, seemingly none the wiser.
“I put you through a lot, Lars-san. Things just sort of swept us along and ended up like this, but thank you.”
“It’s fine…”

A strange silence settled between Father and Panda, indeed. What was going on, with the rest of us right there around them? It seemed Panda had fully regained composure after the confusion of pregnancy.
“Bow Hero-sama, we wanna help take care of Big Sis’s baby too!”
“Yeah, yeah!”
Panda’s subordinates were all clamoring at once, begging Itsuki to let them see, indeed.
“Alright. It’s got a lot of energy, so hold on tight, okay?”
“Thanks so much! Whoa! It’s squirming!”
“So full of energy! Just like Big Sis’s kid!”
“Ooh! Gonna grow up charming just like Big Sis!”

With this many people around, there was no chance of anyone losing sight of the baby. Carelessness is the enemy, but at least I could feel at ease, indeed. Meanwhile Father and the others continued their conversation.
“Once I’m feeling better, I’ll take you to my room sometime. My place is, well, a settlement of a minority tribe and all that…”
“Eh? Oh, right. You told me not to come to your room, so I never have. Panda Village sounds like a place full of wonder to me, honestly.”
“Ohh my~”
Older Sister cut in here with a beaming smile.
“You’re not coming!”
Snap! Panda bared its teeth at Older Sister and wrapped an arm around Father’s waist.
“Oh come on! Sasa-chan, really! If you do it like that, Naofumi-chan won’t understand at all~!”
“Eh? What do you mean by that?”
“Larsa… after all that grilling you gave Shield Hero-sama, what’s brought on this change of heart? You can’t exactly call Sadeena a beast anymore, not with you acting like this.”
Elephant said with an exasperated sigh directed at Panda. Hmm… so getting along well is indeed a good thing!
“Shut it! This is just my nature, so there’s nothing to be done about it, might as well give up trying!”
“Naofumi-chan, once Sasa-chan’s condition stabilizes, when she invites you, you go to her room alone, okay~? Big Sister got turned away, so I’ll have to ask for a different day~.”
“Eh? Eh?”
“I said it’s fine, so don’t worry about it! Got that?! When I call for you, you come to my room!”
“R-right… if you’re okay with it, Lars-san… though maybe it’d be nice to go out somewhere first before heading to your room.”
“Hmph. Looking forward to seeing just how much excitement Shield Hero-sama can bring, I am!”
“Daa! Daa!”
At this point Itsuki and Ren came over, each carrying a baby, to Panda and Older Sister respectively.
“Looks like they’re hungry! Larsazusa-san! Naofumi-san!”
“Ah, yes, yes. Just fed not that long ago, honestly…”
Panda said this while crossing its arms in satisfaction, then took the baby from Itsuki and began feeding it milk, indeed.
“Big Sister’s breasts are gonna shrink at this rate~”

Older Sister too, joking around in her usual manner, was nonetheless diligently attentive in her care. As for what followed, while everyone including Ren and Itsuki was left utterly exhausted from baby care, Father, Older Sister, Panda, Rival, and I handled the childcare without any fatigue whatsoever, indeed. According to Itsuki, Father and the others possessed something like a natural talent for caretaking, he said with no small amount of frustration. I felt like Rival had been watching too, but she should be excluded on account of her species’ natural stamina, indeed.
And so, several days after Father and Panda went on their date, indeed.
“There! You drink too!”
“I understand, I say!”
“Drrrink!”
“Drrrink!”
“Drink up!”

At a tavern in Zeltoble, Ren, Itsuki, and I all got caught up with Panda and its subordinates, and I was made to drink, indeed. We’d come to Zeltoble on errands to shop for supplies when a tipsy Panda spotted us and dragged us into a tavern, and here we are now. Incidentally, according to Panda and its subordinates, apparently Father and Older Sister had taken over childcare duties and sent Panda off to blow off some steam, figuring it must have built up plenty of stress through the whole pregnancy and subsequent childrearing period.
“Why exactly are we here of all places… made to sit through this with tea while we can’t even drink…”
“Shut your yap! If I let you lot drink, that guy’s gonna get mad at me, isn’t he! Instead, let’s just have Spear Hero-sama here drink for the both of you!”
“Urp… I say!”

Being made to gulp down drink after drink, I wasn’t quite dead drunk yet, but I was getting pretty tipsy, indeed. Apparently Panda had gone wild in the Colosseum today, making a comeback as a fighter and getting the crowd all riled up. By the time it found us, Panda had already had quite a bit to drink.
“This is exactly the kind of thing that should be Naofumi-san and Sadeena-san’s job…”
“What are you on about?! If I drank alongside those two, there’s no way my body could keep up!”
Father and Older Sister are frighteningly strong drinkers, after all. What’s more, I’ve never once seen Father drunk in any world, indeed.
“Big Sis! More booze coming through!”
“Gimme! Glug glug! Ahh! There’s nothing like drinking at your own pace!”
Panda, drinking even more than I was, put its mouth to the fresh mug of ale and drained it dry, indeed.

“I think getting Motoyasu-san to drink would work out fine and all, but wouldn’t it make more sense to have Gaelion-san or a dragon drink at a time like this? As drinking buddies, I mean. Filolials don’t seem to like alcohol much.”
“Ah, that one? The dragon folk are no match for me at all.”
“That’s how strong Big Sis’s drinking is!”
“That’s right!”
“As expected of Big Sis!”

According to Older Sister’s account from the original world, the drinking order of strength went Father, Older Sister, Panda, then Rival, followed by her parents, then Big Sister. Elephant, apparently, was about on par with Big Sister relative to her size, indeed.
